project_type: React Native Expo mobile/TV app (streaming service - Netflix-style)
test_framework: No test suite configured in package.json scripts
verification_instructions: 1. Run eslint to check for syntax errors. 2. Verify all modified files are valid JSX (no import errors, no undefined refs). 3. Check that the TV-specific UI changes use TVFocusable and the useIsTV hook properly.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22 available via nvm. No Android emulator, so testing is via lint/export only.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns: use TVFocusable for all focusable elements, useIsTV hook for conditional TV layout, theme.js for shared design tokens.
key_patterns: 1. TVFocusable wraps all interactive elements on TV (animated scale + focus ring). 2. useIsTV hook for runtime TV detection (Platform.isTV + dimension heuristic). 3. isTV static export for module-scope checks. 4. Conditional styles via isTV (e.g. styles.containerTV). 5. TV top nav (TVTopNav in _layout.jsx) replaces bottom tabs. 6. Player uses WebView-based VideoPlayer component. 7. expo-screen-orientation for fullscreen player.
directory_structure: apps/mobile/src/app/ - Expo Router file-based routes. apps/mobile/src/components/ - Shared React Native components. apps/mobile/src/hooks/ - Custom hooks (useIsTV, useMyList). apps/mobile/src/i18n/ - Translations. apps/mobile/src/utils/ - API, player, cache utilities. apps/mobile/src/theme.js - Design tokens.
